summary: Sandbach United's pre-season preparations are in full swing with just one week until the 2026/27 campaign kicks off! The squad has been bolstered by some exciting new signings and a returning player, while the club has also unveiled three brand new kits for the upcoming season. With sponsorship opportunities available and the Ramblers looking sharp ahead of their promotion push, there's plenty of positive momentum building ahead of the big kick-off.
